newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK shares hit new highs in early trade.
newsitem.headline: GREEK shares hit new highs in early trade.

text.p: Greek shares were lifted to new highs in early Monday trade by strong demand in industrial stocks and brokers said large inflows of funds into equities would continue to pull the market higher.
Monday's opening was delayed for 15 minutes due to technical problems which resulted in erroneous price and volume data being transmitted by the bourse in early trade.
Market participants said the market was seen rising further as stocks were chased by large inflows of funds.
"Positive macroeconomic conditions and indications of upbeat corporate profits in 1997 will continue to lift stocks," said Filipos Boukouvalas, fund manager at Kosmos-SocGen mutual funds.
Following a period of scepticism, retail investors are pouring funds into growth funds in the face of drastic cuts in interest rates, he added.
"Sizeable funds are lured into equities on a daily basis, coming both from domestic investors and foreign portfolios," said Thanasis Trikatzis, a broker at Hermes Brokerage.
Foreign investors were getting uneasy by the sharp appreciation in prices.

"Realising the market's strong momentum, foreign players on both sides of the market ask for execution of orders at brokers' discretion rather than giving limit orders because they do not want to miss the rally," Trikatzis said.
The Athens general index was up 0.50 percent or 8.57 points at 1,736.27 from Friday's 1,727.70 after 20 minutes of trading, setting a new all-time high.
Bourse newcomer Xiosbank XIOr.AT made an impressive debut, up 100 percent in very active trading. It went public at 2,650 drachmas a share.
Technical analysis supported the view of a run to higher levels before a consolidation is realised.
"Short-term indicators point to a further rise in the benchmark index to the 1,770 vicinity where it is seen running out of steam," said Omega Securities in its weekly technical analysis report.
Turnover amounted to 22.5 billion drachmas in volume of 1.2 million shares, helped by active trading in new listing Xiosbank.
Advancing stocks led decliners 55 to 16 with 11 stocks unchanged on 82 traded.
